C277.continent_line: North America · Country: Bermuda · ISO: BM
C277.metal: Copper-nickel (75 percent copper, 25 percent nickel) · 2.50 g · 17.8 mm · reeded
C277.design: The obverse shows Queen Elizabeth the Second wearing a tiara and facing right, with the words Elizabeth II Bermuda. The reverse shows a Bermuda lily flower, with the date above it and the words Ten Cents below.
C277.label: Bermuda · 2004 · 10 Cents
C277.notes: Phase 1 from the reverse only (owner photo). Country from the Easter lily design, date and value read from the photo.
C277.story: A 2004 ten-cent coin from Bermuda. The side shown has the Bermuda Easter lily, with the date above it and TEN CENTS below. The other side, not photographed yet, carries Queen Elizabeth II.
